metadata.title: महाराष्ट्र का देसी मुर्गा या कडकनाथ | Desi Murga Or Kadaknath of Jhabua
metadata.description:
From the deep jungles of Satpura in Maharashtra, Shyam Sunder brings a fresh and flavour-packed episode of Tribal Kitchen. Shot on the serene banks of the holy river Narmada, this episode captures not just food, but the soul of the forest and its people.

Amidst a breathtaking location and an electric atmosphere, tribal friends from Teensmal village make a bold claim — the local desi chicken breed of Maharashtra has no comparison, not even with the famous Kadaknath of Jhabua. Praveen Pawara doesn’t mince his words and calls Kadaknath “overrated,” sparking a fiery food debate straight from the jungle.

This episode is full of raw flavours, tribal wisdom, laughter, and honest opinions — where food is cooked with stories, firewood, and friendship. A must-watch for those who believe food is culture.
